It lacks the #10063 `final_ci_*` handling: the early `exit 0` for `JUDGE_SKIP_REASON=final_ci_handover_posted`, the `merge` statuses `final_ci_repair_requested`, `final_ci_handover_posted` and `final_ci_handover`, and the matching three skip-reason arms.
  WHY: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh still emits these values (lines 1987, 2016, 2040, 2080, 2135-2137). Without the branches they fall through to the default CRITICAL messages: repeat hand-overs page a human, the DEBUG and ERROR levels are lost, and `JUDGE_CI_FAILURE_SUMMARY` is never read. `tests/test_review_rb_judge_red_check_repair.py::test_workflow_wires_the_switch_and_the_alert` (lines 407-412) and `test_merge_with_followup_routes_a_red_head` fail. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it BLOCKER; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and openai_gpt-6-luna rated it MAJOR. The highest rating is used here.

PR final CI uses `workflow_dispatch` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:22-28`). The diff changes only the warning fallback to `'400000'` and the watcher default. So a single PR that takes a workflow from under 400,000 bytes to 430,000 or more reaches its size contract tests without an `ai:ci-budget` issue being opened first. - scripts/review_autofix_step_telegram_rb_judge_decision.sh:the `merge` arm of the JUDGE_ACTION case (between the existing `checks_failed` and `manual_merge_required` branches; the three missing `elif` lines correspond to `JUDGE_MERGE_STATUS` values `final_ci_repair_requested`, `final_ci_handover_posted`, and `final_ci_handover`) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The new script drops the three `final_ci_*` merge branches that the deleted inline body in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` had. These statuses now fall to the default "merge did not go through … Needs merge investigation" message at CRITICAL.
  WHY: Each status loses its intended handling:
  - `final_ci_repair_requested` pages at CRITICAL instead of DEBUG.
  - `final_ci_handover_posted` calls `tg_send_tracked` every round instead of being suppressed.
  - `final_ci_handover` loses `JUDGE_CI_FAILURE_SUMMARY` and alerts at CRITICAL instead of ERROR.
  - In `tests/test_review_rb_judge_red_check_repair.py::test_workflow_wires_the_switch_and_the_alert`, `alert.index('elif [ "${JUDGE_MERGE_STATUS}" = "final_ci_handover" ]; then')` raises ValueError.
  This is a documented (#10063) runtime behaviour change.

  Evidence of absence: The job remains restricted to `push` on `main`. A PR that grows a workflow past the 430,000-byte ceiling on its first push gets no `ai:ci-budget` warning before these tests turn red on final CI: `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py::test_post_sync_test_repair_keeps_review_autofix_well_under_the_size_guard`, `tests/test_implement_step_scripts_contract.py` and `tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_step_scripts_contract.py`.
